subject.title: feat(macos): visible-markdown copy, full-message reader, and independent reasoning/tool toggles

question: Should the shared `OpenClawChatTransport` and `OpenClawChatView` contract permanently expose full-message retrieval and independent display options for every native host, with unsupported hosts using the default nil retrieval behavior?
rationale: This is a user-facing feature and public shared-native API expansion rather than a mechanical macOS-only repair; compatibility behavior for other native hosts is an owner decision.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Keep the shared API and nil default transport, with documented unsupported-host behavior and focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Constrain it to macOS
options.body: Move the retrieval and preference behavior behind a macOS-specific boundary if other native hosts should not inherit the new public surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the shared API and nil default transport, with documented unsupported-host behavior and focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the direct author of the native chat implementation, though broader current-main ownership needs confirmation.
